thermal_stationary_snapshots.scope: Exact rational Sturm isolation and signs for this mean-field spectator action. No arbitrary multivariate or flavor-vacuum classification.
thermal_stationary_snapshots.selection_proof: For b>0, opposite signs at equal source amplitude differ by 2*b*abs(u), selecting u>0. In x=u^2,w>=0 the quadratic is strictly convex and -b*sqrt(x) is convex. Hence the positive-source KKT branch is the unique global amplitude minimum; all negative-source branches remain in the stationary census.
